name: Asternodis
description: Asternodis is disaster recovery for Proxmox VE: near-continuous replication of VMs and LXC containers to a second site, non-disruptive DR testing in an isolated network, recovery plans with boot ordering, and one-click failover and failback. It works on any storage backend, including LVM-thin and directory storage that Proxmox cannot natively replicate. Replication runs directly between your two sites over a mutually authenticated channel - no VPN required and no data passes through a third party.

notes.text: The web UI is HTTPS on port 443 with a self-signed certificate generated on first run, so expect a browser warning. You set the admin password during first-run setup.

This installs ONE controller. Disaster recovery needs a controller at each site - run this script at your recovery site as well, then pair the two. A single install can evaluate the product but cannot protect anything on its own.

The controller manages Proxmox over the API and over SSH; it does not run replication itself, so it stays small. It needs network reachability to the nodes it protects and to the controller at the other site.

Commercial software with a free 14-day full-feature trial. A non-commercial Home Lab licence is 99 USD per year per DR Site Pair with no node limit; business licensing starts at 995 USD per year. Failover, failback and abort keep working even if a licence lapses, so licensing can never block a recovery.

/var/lib/asternodis holds the controller database, its encryption key and its peer identity. Back it up - 'asternodis backup' writes a restorable copy - and note that anything able to read it can impersonate this site to its pair.
